dialogues.label: 课文（一）
dialogues.headingEn: Hurry — class is about to start

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.zh: 啊，刮风了。今天天气真冷！
lines.pinyin: A, guā fēng le. Jīntiān tiānqì zhēn lěng!
lines.en: Oh, the wind’s up. It’s really cold today!

lines.speaker: 张东
lines.zh: 是啊，冬天快要到了。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, dōngtiān kuài yào dào le.
lines.en: Yeah — winter’s almost here.

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.zh: 我不喜欢冬天，冬天太冷了！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuan dōngtiān, dōngtiān tài lěng le!
lines.en: I don’t like winter — it’s too cold!

lines.speaker: 张东
lines.zh: 我喜欢冬天。我爱滑冰，也爱滑雪。我们家乡有山有水，是有名的风景区。夏天可以游泳，冬天可以滑雪，一年四季都有去旅游的人，尤其是夏天，山里很凉快，去避暑的人特别多。很多人家都靠经营旅馆、饭店发了财。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan dōngtiān. Wǒ ài huábīng, yě ài huáxuě. Wǒmen jiāxiāng yǒu shān yǒu shuǐ, shì yǒumíng de fēngjǐngqū. Xiàtiān kěyǐ yóuyǒng, dōngtiān kěyǐ huáxuě, yì nián sì jì dōu yǒu qù lǚyóu de rén, yóuqí shì xiàtiān, shān lǐ hěn liángkuai, qù bìshǔ de rén tèbié duō. Hěn duō rénjia dōu kào jīngyíng lǚguǎn, fàndiàn fā le cái.
lines.en: I like winter. I love skating and skiing. Our hometown is a famous scenic area — swim in summer, ski in winter, tourists year-round, especially summer when people escape the heat. Many families got rich running hotels.

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.zh: 我只会滑冰，不会滑雪。我真想到你们家乡去学学滑雪。你看，树叶都红了。红叶真漂亮！等一下儿，我去捡几片红叶。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ huì huábīng, bú huì huáxuě. Wǒ zhēn xiǎng dào nǐmen jiāxiāng qù xuéxue huáxuě. Nǐ kàn, shùyè dōu hóng le. Hóngyè zhēn piàoliang! Děng yíxiàr, wǒ qù jiǎn jǐ piàn hóngyè.
lines.en: I can only skate. I’d love to learn skiing in your hometown. Look — red leaves! Wait, I’ll pick a few.

lines.speaker: 张东
lines.zh: 别捡了，快走吧，要上课了。
lines.pinyin: Bié jiǎn le, kuài zǒu ba, yào shàngkè le.
lines.en: Stop picking — hurry, class is about to start.

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.zh: 着什么急？还早着呢。
lines.pinyin: Zháo shénme jí? Hái zǎo zhe ne.
lines.en: What’s the rush? It’s still early.

lines.speaker: 张东
lines.zh: 你看看表，几点了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kànkan biǎo, jǐ diǎn le?
lines.en: Check your watch — what time is it?

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.zh: 刚七点半。
lines.pinyin: Gāng qī diǎn bàn.
lines.en: Just 7:30.

lines.speaker: 张东
lines.zh: 什么？你的表是不是坏了？
lines.pinyin: Shénme? Nǐ de biǎo shì bu shì huài le?
lines.en: What? Is your watch broken?

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.zh: 哎呀，我的表停了，可能没电了，该换电池了。什么时间了？
lines.pinyin: Āiya, wǒ de biǎo tíng le, kěnéng méi diàn le, gāi huàn diànchí le. Shénme shíjiān le?
lines.en: Oh no — it stopped, maybe dead battery. What time is it?

lines.speaker: 张东
lines.zh: 都七点五十了。快走吧，再不快点儿就迟到了。
lines.pinyin: Dōu qī diǎn wǔshí le. Kuài zǒu ba, zài bù kuài diǎnr jiù chídào le.
lines.en: Already 7:50. Hurry or we’ll be late.

dialogues.label: 课文（二）
dialogues.headingZh: 我姐姐下个月就要结婚了
dialogues.headingEn: My sister is getting married next month

lines.speaker: 玛丽
lines.zh: 山本，有什么好事啦？这么高兴。
lines.pinyin: Shānběn, yǒu shénme hǎoshì la? Zhème gāoxìng.
lines.en: Sachiko, good news? You’re so happy.

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 我母亲来信了。她在信上高兴地说，我姐姐下个月就要结婚了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ mǔqīn lái xìn le. Tā zài xìn shàng gāoxìng de shuō, wǒ jiějie xià ge yuè jiù yào jiéhūn le.
lines.en: Mom wrote — happily saying my sister’s getting married next month.

lines.speaker: 玛丽
lines.zh: 上次你说你姐姐刚找到工作，怎么这么快就要结婚了？
lines.pinyin: Shàng cì nǐ shuō nǐ jiějie gāng zhǎodào gōngzuò, zěnme zhème kuài jiù yào jiéhūn le?
lines.en: Last time you said she just found a job — marrying so soon?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 她未婚夫不愿意让她工作了。
lines.pinyin: Tā wèihūnfū bú yuànyì ràng tā gōngzuò le.
lines.en: Her fiancé doesn’t want her to work anymore.

lines.speaker: 玛丽
lines.zh: 这么说，你姐姐结婚以后就不工作了？
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō, nǐ jiějie jiéhūn yǐhòu jiù bù gōngzuò le?
lines.en: So after marriage she won’t work?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 对。
lines.pinyin: Duì.
lines.en: Right.

lines.speaker: 玛丽
lines.zh: 将来你也会这样吗？结了婚就不工作了吗？
lines.pinyin: Jiānglái nǐ yě huì zhèyàng ma? Jié le hūn jiù bù gōngzuò le ma?
lines.en: Will you be like that too? Stop working after marriage?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 不。我喜欢工作。要是不让我工作，我就不结婚。
lines.pinyin: Bù. Wǒ xǐhuan gōngzuò. Yàoshi bú ràng wǒ gōngzuò, wǒ jiù bù jiéhūn.
lines.en: No. I like working. If I’m not allowed to work, I won’t marry.

notes.title: 着什么急？
notes.body: 句中“什么”用于反问，表示不满，不同意对方说的某一句话。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Zháo shénme jí? Hái zǎo zhe ne.
example.en: What’s the rush? It’s still early.

notes.title: 还早着呢
notes.body: “着呢”用在形容词或某些心理动词后表示程度，相当于“很”。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Hái zǎo zhe ne.
example.en: It’s still quite early.

notes.title: 该…了
notes.body: “该…了”表示根据情理或经验推测必然的或可能的结果。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Gāi huàn diànchí le.
example.en: It’s time to change the battery.

notes.title: 都…了
notes.body: “都…了”中间多为时间词和数量词，表示时间晚、年龄大、数量多。“都”是“已经”的意思。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Dōu qī diǎn wǔshí le.
example.en: It’s already 7:50.

notes.title: 有什么好事啦？
notes.body: “啦”是“了”和“啊”的复合形式。这里表示疑问的语气。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Yǒu shénme hǎoshì la?
example.en: Got some good news?

notes.title: 语气助词“了”（2）：变化
notes.body: 语气助词“了”用在句尾还表示变化。“不…了”也表示变化。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Shùyè yǐjing hóng le.
example.en: The leaves have already turned red.

notes.title: 要…了 / 就要…了 / 快要…了 / 快…了
notes.body: 表示动作即将发生。句中有表示具体时间的词语作状语时不能用“快要…了”，应用“就要…了”。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Dōngtiān kuài yào dào le.
example.en: Winter is about to arrive.

notes.title: 状语与结构助词“地”
notes.body: 结构助词“地”是句中状语的标志。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.zh: 她高兴地说，姐姐下个月就要结婚了。
example.pinyin: Tā gāoxìng de shuō, jiějie xià ge yuè jiù yào jiéhūn le.
example.en: She said happily that her sister is getting married next month.
